empty.sub: Paste a product link from any store and start saving for it.
detail.no_link: No link for this goal: use “Manual price”
money.title: My money
activity.title: Activity
chart.title: Price history
chart.empty_sub: The chart builds up day by day.
edit.link_help: Address of the product page on any store (Amazon, Best Buy, Walmart, eBay, Fnac, idealo…). Empty or unreadable price = you enter the price by hand.
edit.currency_help: Picked up automatically from the page on the first reading.
edit.monthly_help: Used to estimate when you can buy it.
edit.alert: Alert when the price drops below
edit.alert_help: You get a notification when the price falls below this threshold.
edit.delete_q: Delete this goal and its history?
edit.err_amounts: Amounts must be positive numbers (e.g. 50 or 12.5).
edit.err_link: I can't find an http:// or https:// address in this link.
edit.err_empty: Give at least a name or a link.
manual.help: Handy if the site blocks automatic reading. The next automatic reading may replace it.
err.currency_mismatch: The page shows prices in {1} but the goal is in {2}. Change the goal's currency or use “Manual price”.
fetch.refused: The site refused automatic reading (error {1}). Use “Manual price”.
fetch.robot: The site showed an anti-robot check. Try again later or use “Manual price”.
fetch.notfound: Price not found on this page (page received: {1}). Use “Manual price”.
acct.intro: Get the same goals on your phone and your computer, with your GitHub account. Nothing else to create.
acct.step1: Tap the button below: GitHub opens the creation of a token already set to “gist”.
acct.step2: Set Expiration to “No expiration”, then tap “Generate token” at the bottom.
acct.step3: Copy the token (it starts with ghp_) and paste it here.
acct.connected_info: Your goals, savings and history are the same on your phone and your computer. Connect the other device with the same GitHub account.
acct.disconnect_msg: Your goals stay on this phone but will no longer be synced.
acct.privacy1: They are stored in a “secret gist” on your GitHub account: it isn't listed publicly, but anyone who has its link could read it. It only contains the names, prices and amounts of your goals. Your token stays in your phone's keychain.
acct.privacy2: If you edit the same goal on two devices at the same time, the most recent change wins.
sync.err.token: Token refused: it is invalid or has expired.
sync.err.forbidden: GitHub denies access (token without the “gist” permission, or limit reached).
sync.err.notfound: Online data not found (gist deleted?). Sign out and sign in again.
sync.err.nofile: Data file missing from the gist.
sync.err.unreadable: The online data file is unreadable.
sort.name: Name
set.currency_help: Each goal's currency is set in its own sheet. New goals use the default currency, then the one found on the product page.
set.refresh_help: At the latest each time you open the app. In the background, Android picks the exact time to save battery.
set.confetti: Confetti when a goal is reached
set.data_help: Save all your goals to a file, or restore them from a file. Restoring merges with what you already have.
tuto.welcome.title: Welcome!
tuto.welcome.text: Pick a product, set money aside and watch the gauge fill up. Let's start with your language.
tuto.theme.title: Make it yours
tuto.theme.text: Pick a theme and an accent colour. You can change everything later in Settings, along with fonts, text size and more.
tuto.link.title: Add a product
tuto.link.text: Tap + in the Goals tab, then paste the product link. The price is read automatically and tracked day after day.
tuto.link.manual: If a site blocks reading, or with no link, you can enter the price by hand with “Manual price”. Each goal has its own currency.
tuto.money.title: Your money
tuto.money.text: In a goal's page, enter an amount then tap Add when you save, or Withdraw when you take some back.
tuto.money.hint: The ring, the chart and the estimated purchase date update right away.
tuto.alerts.title: Follow the price
tuto.alerts.text: The app reads the price and keeps its history. Set an alert threshold and get a notification when the price drops.
tuto.alerts.hint: You can do this later in Android Settings.
tuto.sync.title: On all your devices
tuto.sync.text: Connect your GitHub account in the Account tab to get the same goals on your phone and your computer.
tuto.sync.hint: The app works fine without an account. You can replay this tutorial any time from Settings.
advice.title: Good time to buy?
advice.high: Price is on the high side: you can wait
advice.need_data: Not enough readings to judge (at least 3 needed).
stats.title: Statistics
stats.streak_sub: weeks in a row with a deposit
save.help_reminder: You get a notification to remind you to save. Tap “Add” in the notification to record it in one go.
save.help_auto: The app adds this amount to your savings every month on that day (tracking only: no money is moved). Turn it on on one device only.
err.save_amount: Enter an amount above 0 for the automatic deposit.
